en-US.description: Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust.
An open-source, clean-room take on the Adobe Premiere Pro workflow: native on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly. By the ArtCraft team.
Premiere 26's full Video Effects bin (93 effects in 16 folders), the Legacy bin and the obsolete effects old projects use, plus around 30 transitions.
en-US.name: FilmCraft
en-US.releaseNotes:
Note
FreeBSD aarch64 is dropped from this release. We had to cut releases, and we cannot build this target within the 5-hour CI limit for any of the Craft apps, so we are dropping it for now. This is a known blocker, flagged for a future fix in storytold/craft-common-actions#39. FreeBSD x86_64 and every other platform are included.
What's Changed
- docs: add SonarCloud and CodeRabbit badges to README by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2368
- Skip CodeRabbit reviews on Dependabot PRs by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2594
- ci: switch to shared nix workflow from craft-common-actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2157
- fix(macos): ask to save on Cmd-Q instead of quitting outright (#1943) by @ssandweiss in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2006
- Order auto-saves by real time so rotation keeps the newest by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1955
- #2342: CLI file.exportMedia waits for the export before the process exits by @Felix-Helleckes in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2388
- engine: preserve existing files when AAF/OMF imports embedded audio by @nuclearspike in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2023
- codecs: avoid duration-sized silence allocation for damaged MP4 audio by @nuclearspike in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1987
- Re-open a failed audio output while playing instead of going silent for good by @justacalico in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2555
- Hostile-input hardening for video decoders (AV1 panic + oversize allocation, MPEG-2 allocation) and fuzz tests by @g1obalworlds in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1795
- fix: use async file I/O in async MCP handler (SonarCloud rust:S7493) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2724
- security: validate CLI paths/args in dev tools (SonarCloud S2083/S8707/S8705) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2723
- security: enforce HTTPS on curl downloads (SonarCloud S6506) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2720
- README: the app icon above the title by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2763
New Contributors
- @justacalico made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2555
- @g1obalworlds made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1795
- @bflatastic made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2763
Full Changelog: https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/compare/v0.10.0...v0.11.0

zh-CN.description: 视频剪辑、调色与声音；以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Premiere Pro 净室重实现
zh-CN.longDescription:
视频剪辑、调色与声音；一个以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Premiere Pro 净室重实现。
对 Adobe Premiere Pro 工作流的开源净室重现：macOS、Windows 和 Linux 原生应用，并可通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中使用。由 ArtCraft 团队打造。
包含 Premiere 26 的完整视频效果箱（16 个文件夹中的 93 种效果）、传统效果箱和旧项目使用的过时效果，以及约 30 种转场。
